definitions.explanation: The property of transmitting or receiving signals, sound, or energy more effectively in a particular direction. Used in audio engineering, telecommunications, and antenna design.

examples.japanese: {指向性|しこうせい}マイクを{使|つか}う。
このアンテナは{強|つよ}い{指向性|しこうせい}を{持|も}っている。
{指向性|しこうせい}の{高|たか}いスピーカーは{特定|とくてい}の{方向|ほうこう}にだけ{音|おと}を{届|とど}ける。
examples.english: A highly directional speaker delivers sound only in a specific direction.

notes:
A technical term referring to the property of transmitting or receiving signals, sound, or energy more effectively in a particular direction. Used mainly in audio engineering, telecommunications, and antenna design.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指向性|しこうせい}マイク: directional microphone
- {指向性|しこうせい}アンテナ: directional antenna
- {指向性|しこうせい}スピーカー: directional speaker
- {指向性|しこうせい}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い: high/low directivity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指向性|しこうせい}: directional
- {無指向性|むしこうせい}: omnidirectional (picks up from all directions)
- {単一指向性|たんいつしこうせい}: unidirectional (cardioid pattern)
